Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
# create a set of suspicious TGA variants for manual testing via harness later if needed
cases=[]
# raw 1x1 24/32-bit
for bpp in [15,16,24,32]:
    hdr=bytearray(18); hdr[2]=2; hdr[12:14]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[14:16]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[16]=bpp
    cases.append((f'raw_{bpp}.tga', bytes(hdr)))
# RLE 1x1 with only packet header
for bpp in [24,32]:
    hdr=bytearray(18); hdr[2]=10; hdr[12:14]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[14:16]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[16]=bpp
    cases.append((f'rle_{bpp}.tga', bytes(hdr)+b'\x00'))
# indexed paletted with no palette/image
hdr=bytearray(18); hdr[1]=1; hdr[2]=1; hdr[5:7]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[7]=24; hdr[12:14]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[14:16]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[16]=8
cases.append(('idx.tga', bytes(hdr)))
for name,data in cases:
    Path('/workspace/'+name).write_bytes(data)
    print(name, len(data))
PY
printf 'done\n'
